item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Sunday 21 December In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Sunday, 21 December—politics, crime, sports, and more—all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Dense fog disrupts rail services, over 20 trains cancelled; Here’s the list
item.description: Dense fog, severe cold, and poor visibility have disrupted railway operations across North India. To ensure passenger safety, Indian Railways canceled over 20 trains, while many others are running late. Morning and late-night services are most affected due to extremely low visibility.

item.title: Yunus pays tribute to Sharif Osman Hadi; Vows to carry forward his ideals
item.description: Bangladesh interim government adviser Muhammad Yunus attended the funeral of student leader Sharif Osman Hadi, pledging to uphold his political ideals. Hadi, a prominent figure in last year’s student movement, was killed while campaigning for upcoming elections.

item.title: Horoscope 2026: New Year brings financial stability and growth for Libra zodiac sign
item.description: The year 2026 is expected to bring financial stability and career growth for Libra natives, according to astrologer Dr. Diwakar Tripathi. New income opportunities, career advancement, and family happiness are indicated. While students may face stress, success is likely with effort.

item.title: Gold prices rise slightly, Silver surges Rs 16,000 in a week; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices in India rose marginally over the past week, while silver witnessed a massive surge. Twenty-four-carat gold gained ₹260 per 10 grams, whereas silver jumped ₹16,000 per kg. Global cues, including expectations of US rate cuts, supported precious metals.

item.title: Nora Fatehi car hit by drunk driver in Mumbai; Shares health update
item.description: Actor Nora Fatehi shared a health update after being involved in a car accident in Mumbai caused by a drunk driver. She sustained minor injuries and a slight concussion but is safe. Despite the incident, Nora performed on stage with DJ David Guetta the same evening.

item.title: Sultanpur’s most wanted criminal Siraj Ahmed injured in encounter; Major weapons seized
item.description: Sultanpur's wanted criminal, Siraj Ahmed, who has 30 cases registered against him for murder and other serious crimes, was arrested by the police during a cordon and search operation in the Gangoh police station area of ​​Saharanpur. Siraj was seriously injured in the exchange of fire with the police.

item.title: New year terror plot foiled, terrorists eye Pathankot for attacks; Click for details
item.description: A plot by terrorists to attack Pathankot on New Year's Eve has been uncovered. A Pakistan-based terrorist organization is planning to attack the airbase, railway station, and other sensitive areas in Pathankot. The Punjab Police have detained a local accomplice, Billu Gujjar. Security forces have increased vigilance in the district, and strict checks are being conducted at interstate checkpoints.

item.title: ‘Aravalli is Delhi’s natural shield’, Akhilesh Yadav targets BJP’s mining policies
item.description: Former UP Chief Minister Akhilesh Yadav described the Aravalli mountain range as the natural protective shield of Delhi and the NCR and urged citizens to protect it. He warned that if the destruction of the Aravallis continues, Delhi will face serious problems such as pollution, water scarcity, and rising temperatures.

item.title: Mass shooting in Johannesburg leaves 9 dead, 10 injured; Details here
item.description: Unidentified gunmen opened fire indiscriminately at a bar in Bekkersdal, Johannesburg, South Africa, in the early hours of Sunday morning. The attack left nine people dead and 10 others injured. According to police, the attackers also fired shots on the tavern and surrounding streets.
